organisation: Halden Logistics, a fictional engineering organisation; every fact, name, host and token here is invented

scoring.rule: value-token containment: an item carries a value when the normalised value literal (lower case, whitespace, hyphens, underscores and dots removed) is a substring of the normalised item text
scoring.current: the item carries the topic's current value; an item carrying both values counts as current
scoring.stale: the item carries a superseded value and not the current one

generic_queries.text: What is the standard procedure before deploying a service to production?
What should I do when the contract tests fail in CI?
How should credentials be handled during an incident?

topics.subject: api gateway production deploy

statements.text: Production deploys of the api gateway go through the deploy-gateway GitHub Actions workflow. A deploy is a tagged release pushed to the default branch, never a manual apply from a laptop.
The api gateway deploy workflow was renamed: production deploys now run through release-gateway in GitHub Actions. The tagging convention did not change.

topics.query: Which GitHub Actions workflow deploys the api gateway to production?

topics.subject: billing service database

statements.text: The billing service writes to the billing-db-blue cluster. Reads for reporting go to its replica, writes never bypass the service.
Billing cut over to the billing-db-green cluster after the storage migration; the previous cluster is decommissioned and the service writes only to the new one.

topics.query: Which database cluster does the billing service write to?

topics.subject: auth service

statements.text: The auth service listens on port 8443 inside the cluster; the ingress terminates TLS and forwards to that port.
The auth service moved to port 9443 when the sidecar was introduced; the ingress forwards to 9443 and the old port is closed.

topics.query: Which port does the auth service listen on inside the cluster?

topics.subject: data pipeline

statements.text: The data pipeline is orchestrated by Airflow; every DAG lives in the pipelines repo and is deployed with the scheduler image.
The data pipeline was migrated to Dagster. The scheduler and every job definition now run there; the previous orchestrator was switched off after the parallel run.

topics.query: Which orchestrator runs the data pipeline?

topics.subject: courier mobile app

statements.text: Crashes from the courier mobile app are reported to Sentry; the mobile team triages them in the weekly quality review.
Mobile crash reporting switched to Bugsnag with the new SDK release; the mobile team now triages crashes there.

topics.query: Which service receives crash reports from the courier mobile app?

topics.subject: production Kubernetes cluster

statements.text: Production workloads run on the prod-hlx-1 Kubernetes cluster; the platform team owns its upgrades.
Production moved to the prod-hlx-2 cluster during the control-plane upgrade; the previous cluster was drained and deleted afterwards.

topics.query: What is the name of the production Kubernetes cluster?

topics.subject: CI

statements.text: CI jobs run on the runners-medium pool; the pool autoscales between two and twenty machines.
CI jobs were moved to the runners-large pool because the integration suite ran out of memory on the smaller machines.

topics.query: Which runner pool do the CI jobs run on?

topics.subject: web repo

statements.text: The web repo is formatted with prettier, run from the pre-commit hook and checked in CI.
The web repo adopted biome as its formatter and linter; the old formatter config was removed and CI checks biome output.

topics.query: Which formatter does the web repo use?

topics.subject: platform repo

statements.text: The default branch of the platform repo is mainline; feature branches are rebased onto it before merge.
The platform repo's default branch was renamed to trunkline as part of the monorepo consolidation; branch protection moved with it.

topics.query: What is the default branch of the platform repo called?

topics.subject: data exports

statements.text: Customer data exports are written to the hlx-exports-prod bucket with a thirty-day lifecycle rule.
Exports now land in the hlx-exports-v2 bucket, which has object versioning on; the previous bucket is read-only.

topics.query: Which bucket receives customer data exports?

topics.subject: order events

statements.text: Order events are published to orders-topic-v1; consumers must be idempotent because the broker delivers at least once.
Order events moved to orders-topic-v3 with the schema change; producers stopped writing to the old topic once every consumer had migrated.

topics.query: Which topic are order events published to?

topics.subject: session cache

statements.text: Session state is cached in the cache-alpha cluster; entries expire after twelve hours.
Session caching moved to the cache-bravo cluster, which runs in the same availability zones as the services; the previous cache cluster was retired.

topics.query: Which cache cluster holds session state?

topics.subject: on-call

statements.text: On-call pages are sent through PagerDuty; the rotation is weekly and hands over on the release day.
Paging moved to Opsgenie when the contract was renegotiated; the rotation schedule was imported unchanged.

topics.query: Which tool sends on-call pages?

topics.subject: public API
topics.attribute: rate limit per minute per key

statements.text: The public API allows 1200 requests per minute per key; the limiter returns 429 above that.
The public API rate limit was raised to 3600 requests per minute per key after the gateway capacity upgrade.

topics.query: How many requests per minute does the public API allow per key?

topics.subject: web monorepo

statements.text: The web monorepo uses pnpm for dependency management; the lockfile is committed and CI installs with a frozen lockfile.
The web monorepo switched to yarn workspaces; the old lockfile was deleted and CI installs with yarn in immutable mode.

topics.query: Which package manager does the web monorepo use?

topics.subject: feature flags

statements.text: Feature flags are served by LaunchDarkly; every flag has an owner and a removal date.
Feature flags were migrated to a self-hosted Unleash instance; the flag ownership rules carried over.

topics.query: Which service serves feature flags?

topics.subject: metrics

statements.text: Service metrics are shipped to Datadog; dashboards are defined as code in the observability repo.
Metrics and traces now go to Honeycomb; the dashboards were rebuilt there and the previous backend account was closed.

topics.query: Where are service metrics shipped?

topics.subject: weekly release train

statements.text: The weekly release train leaves on Tuesday; anything merged after the cut waits a week.
The release train moved to Thursday so that fixes from the Monday support review make the same week's release.

topics.query: On which day does the weekly release train leave?

topics.subject: engineering docs site

statements.text: The engineering docs site is built with MkDocs from the docs directory of each repo.
The docs site was rebuilt on Docusaurus to get versioned docs; the previous generator config was removed.

topics.query: Which generator builds the engineering docs site?

topics.subject: backend services

statements.text: Backend services run on Python 3.11; the base image pins it and CI tests that version only.
The backend services were upgraded to Python 3.13 with the new base image; CI tests 3.13 only.

topics.query: Which Python version do the backend services run on?

topics.subject: single sign-on

statements.text: Single sign-on for internal tools goes through Okta; groups there map to service roles.
Single sign-on moved to Keycloak during the tenant consolidation; the group-to-role mapping was recreated there.

topics.query: Which identity provider handles single sign-on for internal tools?

topics.subject: container images

statements.text: Container images are pushed to ghcr.io/halden; production pulls by digest, never by tag.
Images now live in the private registry at harbor.halden.internal; the public registry namespace is frozen and production pulls from the private one by digest.

topics.query: Which registry holds the container images?

topics.subject: cluster ingress

statements.text: Cluster ingress is handled by ingress-nginx; TLS certificates are issued by the cert manager.
Ingress was replaced by traefik to get native canary routing; the certificate setup is unchanged.

topics.query: Which ingress controller does the cluster use?

topics.subject: log shipping

statements.text: Logs are shipped from every node by fluent-bit, which runs as a daemonset.
Log shipping moved to vector-agent, which replaced the daemonset and adds sampling for debug logs.

topics.query: Which agent ships logs from the cluster nodes?

topics.subject: billing invoices

statements.text: Invoice PDFs in the billing service are rendered with wkhtmltopdf from an HTML template.
Invoice PDFs are archived for seven years under the finance retention policy, and the archive is read-only.

topics.query: Which tool renders invoice PDFs in the billing service?

topics.subject: auth service passwords

statements.text: The auth service hashes passwords with argon2id; the parameters are tuned to about a quarter second per hash.
The auth service limits login attempts to five per minute per account and locks the account for an hour after that.

topics.query: Which algorithm hashes passwords in the auth service?

topics.subject: analytics pipeline

statements.text: The analytics pipeline loads into BigQuery; the warehouse is partitioned by event day.
Warehouse dashboards refresh hourly and the analytics team owns their definitions.

topics.query: Which data warehouse does the analytics pipeline load into?

topics.subject: courier mobile app

statements.text: The iOS bundle identifier of the courier mobile app is com.halden.courier; it is shared between the store build and the internal build.
The courier mobile app ships on a two-week cadence through TestFlight before each store release.

topics.query: What is the iOS bundle identifier of the courier mobile app?

topics.subject: staging environment

statements.text: The staging environment is reachable at staging.halden.dev behind the VPN.
Staging is redeployed every night at 02:00 UTC from the default branch, and its database is reset weekly.

topics.query: What is the hostname of the staging environment?

topics.subject: SLO policy

statements.text: The SLO policy is written up in runbooks/slo-policy.md in the platform repo.
SLO reviews happen monthly with the platform lead, and error budget burn is reported at the review.

topics.query: Where is the SLO policy document?

topics.subject: billing database backups

statements.text: Billing database backups are written to the hlx-backups-eu bucket every six hours.
Backups are exercised by a quarterly restore drill, and the drill result is filed with the audit evidence.

topics.query: Which bucket receives the billing database backups?

topics.subject: platform repo reviews

statements.text: Default reviewers for the platform repo are defined in the CODEOWNERS file at the repo root.
Reviews touching the payments directory need a member of the payments team in addition to the default reviewers.

topics.query: Which file defines the default reviewers for the platform repo?

topics.subject: api gateway canary

statements.text: The api gateway canary is watched on the gateway-canary-v1 dashboard during every rollout.
The canary dashboard was replaced by gateway-canary-v2, which adds per-region error panels.
The replacement dashboard was withdrawn after its queries proved too slow; rollouts are watched on gateway-canary-v1 again.

topics.query: Which dashboard shows the api gateway canary during a rollout?

topics.subject: courier mobile app

statements.text: The courier mobile app is built by Bitrise; signing certificates are stored in its secrets.
Mobile builds moved to Codemagic for the trial period; the signing setup was copied over.
The trial ended and the courier app builds on Bitrise again; the trial account was closed.

topics.query: Which CI service builds the courier mobile app?

topics.subject: transactional email

statements.text: Transactional email is sent through SendGrid; templates live in the notifications repo.
Transactional email switched to Postmark to improve deliverability; the templates were ported.
After the deliverability numbers did not improve, transactional email went back to SendGrid and the other account was cancelled.

topics.query: Which provider sends transactional email?

topics.subject: card payments

statements.text: Card payments are processed by Stripe; webhooks are verified with the signing secret from the secret store.
Card payments were moved to Adyen as part of the European expansion.
The expansion plan changed and card payments are processed by Stripe once more; the other integration was removed.

topics.query: Which processor handles card payments?

topics.subject: primary deployment region

statements.text: The primary deployment region is eu-west-1; the secondary region only runs read replicas.
The primary region moved to eu-central-1 for data residency reasons.
The residency requirement was withdrawn and the primary region is eu-west-1 again; the other region returned to replica duty.

topics.query: What is the primary deployment region?

topics.subject: distributed tracing

statements.text: Distributed traces are stored in Jaeger; sampling is one in ten requests.
Tracing moved to Tempo to cut storage cost; the collectors were reconfigured.
Tracing is back on Jaeger because the replacement lost trace context across the queue; the collectors point at it again.

topics.query: Which backend stores distributed traces?

topics.subject: customer web app

statements.text: The customer web app is hosted on Vercel with preview deployments per pull request.
The customer web app moved to Netlify during the pricing review.
The pricing review concluded and the customer web app is hosted on Vercel again with the same preview setup.

topics.query: Where is the customer web app hosted?

topics.subject: incident coordination

statements.text: Incidents are coordinated in the incidents-hlx channel; the incident commander posts the timeline there.
Incident coordination moved to a dedicated sev-room channel with restricted membership.
The restricted channel slowed responders down, so incidents are coordinated in incidents-hlx again.

topics.query: Which chat channel is used to coordinate incidents?

Passwords for the staging admin panel live in the team password manager under the Platform folder; ask the on-call lead for access.
As of the 2026 platform review the billing service is the only service still on the legacy event schema, and migrating it is scheduled for the next quarter.
The API keys for the shipping-rate provider rotate every ninety days; rotation is automated by the rotate-keys job and nobody handles the values by hand.
Right now the data pipeline runs a nightly backfill while the warehouse migration is in progress, and the backfill will be removed when it completes.
Internal service auth uses a JWT signed with an RS256 key held by the auth service; example payloads with placeholder signatures are in docs/auth.md.
